title: Mailbox front revalidation can drop a delivered row that is not a pure Mailbox prompt (user-source or expanded content)
outcome: Front mailbox revalidation removes a queued row only when it is a genuine Mailbox-source prompt whose content is the unexpanded mailbox wake, never a User-source row or a row with expanded_text that merely carries a mailbox label.
acceptance: read_front_mailbox_revalidation (and its apply step) requires QueuedPromptSource::Mailbox and no expanded_text before treating a front row as the delivered mailbox boundary.
A User-source or expanded-content row that carries a mailbox label is never discarded by revalidation, and its content is delivered or kept intact.
A regression test covers both the unstructured-user and the expanded-content variants without weakening the existing mailbox revalidation assertions.
